label: D1 after a common a2->S2 transition (sparse)
explanation: Fires only at D1 (never GO or D2). Almost all mass (78% overall; essentially all where the previous trial is in the window) comes from D1 steps where the previous trial chose a2 and had a common transition to S2. Only 46 activations follow a1 or rare trials. The remaining ~22% are on the window first trial (rel -3), where the previous trial is not visible, so they are presumably the same context. Precision is low (~0.19): inside this context it fires on only about 1 in 5 steps, and no observed variable I tried raises that (previous reward, good state, value band, repeated a2, policy-logit band). So the gating depends on some internal state I did not capture. It fires whether or not the previous trial was rewarded. The top-activation examples are mostly unrewarded (r0) D1 steps, while rewarded D1s fill the 2nd activation quartile, so a missing reward seems to raise magnitude (seen only qualitatively in the examples). It correlates with the upcoming a2 choice and S2 being good, but that is downstream of the a2-common history. All variables used are observed at D1.
